answer: Make every new identity grow up in public: it earns nothing for its first few epochs, and its standing decays like an echo fading unless it keeps doing verified work. A clone farm then faces a nebula of idle mouths — thousands of identities that cost upkeep yet pay nothing until they mature, and each one needs fresh work every epoch just to stay alive. Only a whisper of patience separates an honest newcomer, who matures once, from a farmer, who must mature a thousand clones forever.
